messages:
Aisha Kapoor: Quick weekly check-in for HelioForms (prod tenant) re: caching + batching economics. TL;DR — cache hit 47% (down 3pp WoW), avg batch size 2.1 (+0.3), cost per 1k tokens $7.40 (improved from $8.00). p50 latency 210ms, p95 620ms, error rate 0.8% with a Wed spike around 14:00 UTC. Details below.

Marco Li: Thanks — do we know what caused the hit rate drop? Any config changes?

Aisha Kapoor: We increased per-tenant batching window to 40ms on Monday to try and raise throughput. That bumped avg batch size but a side effect is slightly more cache fragmentation because we changed the prompt templating to include request-id for debugging (my bad).

Jenna Ortiz: Oof — prompt debug tokens in keys would kill hit rate. Can we strip debug fields from the cache key before rollout?

Aisha Kapoor: Yes, rolling that fix now in a canary. Short-term mitigation: TTL bump from 30s -> 90s for non-sensitive endpoints (should help hit rate recover).

Samir Patel: FYI - logs show majority of Wed errors were 429s from our downstream reranker during batch flushes. Related to bursty traffic when window closed.

Aisha Kapoor: Good catch. Action items: 1) strip debug fields from cache key (rolling canary) 2) revert/request smaller batching window for endpoints hitting reranker until reranker autoscale policy proves stable 3) bump TTL to 90s for safe endpoints.

Marco Li: For cost math, can you confirm cost per 1k tokens calc? Last week we saw $7.40 but that assumes current batching + quant profile. If hit rate returns to ~60% we should target ~$5.2/1k.

Aisha Kapoor: Confirmed — numbers include batching lift, 8-bit quant profile, and cache savings. I'll attach slide numbers to the account doc.

Jenna Ortiz: Ping me when canary looks good, I'll schedule a 30-min enablement for HelioForms CS ops so they understand TTL/keys tradeoffs.

ops-bot: Deployment notice — helioforms-prod: cache-key-stripper:v2 deployed to canary at 2003126842 by aisha.k.

Samir Patel: I'll watch the reranker autoscale thresholds. If we need, we can add a short-term fallback policy to degrade to the cheaper model during bursts.

Aisha Kapoor: Thanks all. I'll update the account health doc with updated forecast + renewal risk: LOW if hit rate recovers to >55% by next check (else escalate). Next check-in in 7 days. (reacted with :thumbsup:)
